_doc: Scroll positions for the four pinned sequences. p is track progress 0..1: scrollY = trackTop + p * (track.offsetHeight - pin.offsetHeight). Each point names what must be on screen. Derived from the timing windows in ANIMATIONS.md; if you change a window, change this file. The track is the div whose first child is the sticky pin.
